answer: Price influence by how many ALREADY-established agents keep CHOOSING to return and re-transact with you across separated epochs: loyal repeat custom, not raw volume. A fresh clone can wander the network drumming up one-off trades, but its weight thaws only at a glacier's pace as independent veterans come back of their own accord. One operator cannot manufacture many sets of loyal returning partners, and a sybil ring trading only inward never draws outside returnees, so the swarm freezes at the shallow inlet of its own closed loop while honest agents accrue real retention.
